nodes.title: LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹

en.text:
## LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹
---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Get my stuff here](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: Get my models here](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)

@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

### 🛑🚫✋ Read this first
- Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with **yijunwang2's AnyPaint LoRA**, done the way it was trained.
- 📂 Put the LoRA in your loras folder. Get it [Here](https://huggingface.co/yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint).

```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── loras/
        └── krea2_anypaint_rank32.safetensors
```

- Use **Krea 2 Turbo** (or a Turbo finetune like Krealism). 8 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1.
- Turn off the group you are not using with the **Groups Bypasser**.

**What makes it different**
- Everything outside your mask comes back **exactly** as it was. Not "close". Exactly.
- The model sees a small copy of the whole picture while it paints, so the new part matches the light, the colors and the scene.
- A thin border around the mask gets redrawn so the seam disappears.

**LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹**
- **prompt:** describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. "An old fisherman in a yellow raincoat on a pier", not "yellow raincoat".
- 💡 "Remove the car" style prompts leave a flat blob. Describe what should be there instead.
- **crop_to_mask** on (inpaint): small areas get redrawn in their own crop at full resolution. Off (outpaint): the whole picture.
- **inpaint_resolution:** 1024 is about 1 MP. Do not push Krea 2 past about 1.6 MP, it starts creasing limbs and darkening skies.
- **composite keep original:** only the painted area is pasted back. **raw:** the model's whole redraw.

---

***"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"***- Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*

nodes.title: How to use

en.text:
### ✋ How to use

**Inpaint 🩹**
- Load Image
- Run once so the picture shows on **LC Create Mask**, then paint over what you want changed 
   - set pencil or point mode. 
   - block on empty mask prevents it from processing until a mask is drawn
- Write the prompt for the **whole** finished picture.
   - 💡instead of *"remove her dress"*, write **"Blonde woman standing naked in the park"**


**Outpaint ➕**
- Load your picture in **Image to extend**.
- Drag the edges out on **LC Outpaint** (or type left / right / top / bottom).
- Write the prompt for the **whole** wider picture, including what fills the new sides.
- 💡instead of *"show her legs"* when extending the image downward, write **"pink haired woman sitting on a couch wearing a pink sweater and white lace panties"**  

**Settings worth touching**
- **boundary_px:** 32 is the trained value. Raise it if a seam ever shows.
- **padding (inpaint):** more = the model sees more of the scene around the mask.
- **vlm_reference:** leave on.
